purpose: Ensure validation and full-corpus evaluation reload corrected checkpoints with SentenceTransformers input flattening explicitly disabled.

freeze_context.note: This child lock fixes only the reload-time implementation: can_flatten_inputs is not serialized by SentenceTransformers checkpoints. It does not change any metric, task, recipe-selection rule, or statistical endpoint.

input_execution.enforcement: Every evaluator sets the first SentenceTransformers module to false after checkpoint load and fails if the value cannot be observed or retained.
input_execution.training_receipt_requirement: Every evaluated completed.json must contain the identical independently_padded receipt.

validation.role: Select one final-checkpoint learning rate per optimizer using the parent protocol only.

beir.task_parallelism: one task per visible GPU with deterministic longest-corpus-first scheduling
beir.checkpoint_identity: Every resumable result root is content-addressed by checkpoint safetensors digest before scoring.
beir.source_identity: The result runtime manifest hashes the corrected wrapper and every historical worker/helper source it imports.

compatibility_boundary.reason: Historical source-bound evidence remains immutable; corrected caches live in new namespaces.

claim_boundary: This implementation lock prevents reload-time execution drift. Scientific interpretation remains governed by the parent corrective protocol.
